deadline.value: Applications can be submitted at any time, so there is no fixed closing date for this PhD.
deadline.quote: For other doctoral programmes, you can submit an Application for Admission at any time.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You do not need a supervisor agreed before applying, but acceptance depends on staff availability for supervision.
supervisor.quote: You are not required to have organised a supervisor yet. The department will contact you to confirm or discuss available supervision.

also.quote: Acceptance is subject to staff availability for supervision, and appropriate facilities.

funding.value: Funding comes through the competitive University of Auckland Doctoral Scholarship; no guaranteed funding is stated.
funding.quote: The University of Auckland Doctoral Scholarship (UoADS) is a competitive scholarship scheme in 4 rounds each year.

entry_route.value: Entry needs either a postgraduate honours degree or a master's degree, each with a University of Auckland equivalent B+ grade.
entry_route.quote: You need to have completed a postgraduate bachelors (honours) degree with a University of Auckland equivalent B+ grade, or a masters degree with a University of Auckland equivalent B+ grade in a relevant field.

notes: Department page lists research areas and an apply link only; no department-specific fee, GRE or English rule.
